Our Services

Complete Maritime &
Energy Services

From pre-arrival documentation to petroleum product brokerage — Dolphintech handles every aspect of your maritime and energy logistics in Nigeria, 24 hours a day.

🚢
Ship Agency
Pre-arrival documentation, NPA/NIMASA/Immigration clearance, pilotage, berthing, cargo oversight, and disbursement accounting at all Nigerian ports.
Full details
⛽
Petroleum Brokerage
Crude oil, refined products and LPG trading and brokerage. DPR-licensed, with deep relationships across NNPC, IOCs and independent marketers.
Full details
🔄
STS Operations
Ship-to-ship cargo transfers coordinated safely and efficiently in Nigerian waters, with full MARPOL compliance and experienced STS superintendents.
Full details
📄
Vessel Chartering
Time charter, voyage charter and bareboat arrangements for tankers, bulk carriers, barges and offshore support vessels across West Africa.
Full details
📦
Freight & Clearing
Import and export customs clearance, freight forwarding, and cargo documentation at Apapa, Tin Can, Onne, Calabar and all major Nigerian ports.
Full details
⚙️
Marine Supply & Logistics
Bunker supply, fresh water, provisions, spare parts delivery and crew change coordination for vessels at anchor or alongside Nigerian berths.
Full details
